role_assignments_revocation_pair_check.name: role_assignments_revocation_pair_check
role_assignments_revocation_pair_check.value: ("role_assignments"."status" = 'active' and "role_assignments"."revoked_at" is null and "role_assignments"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("role_assignments"."status" = 'revoked' and "role_assignments"."revoked_at" is not null and "role_assignments"."revocation_reason" is not null)

oauth_transactions_session_user_check.name: oauth_transactions_session_user_check
oauth_transactions_session_user_check.value: "oauth_transactions"."session_id" is null or "oauth_transactions"."user_id" is not null

sessions_revocation_pair_check.name: sessions_revocation_pair_check
sessions_revocation_pair_check.value: ("sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "sessions"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and "sessions"."revocation_reason" is not null)

notification_deliveries_envelope_state_c.name: notification_deliveries_envelope_state_check
notification_deliveries_envelope_state_c.value: ("notification_deliveries"."payload_cleared_at" is null and num_nonnulls("notification_deliveries"."encryption_key_version", "notification_deliveries"."payload_iv", "notification_deliveries"."payload_ciphertext", "notification_deliveries"."payload_auth_tag") = 4) or ("notification_deliveries"."payload_cleared_at" is not null and num_nonnulls("notification_deliveries"."encryption_key_version", "notification_deliveries"."payload_iv", "notification_deliveries"."payload_ciphertext", "notification_deliveries"."payload_auth_tag") = 0)

invitations_active_organization_email_un.name: invitations_active_organization_email_unique
invitations_active_organization_email_un.where: "invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."superseded_at" is null

invitations_acceptance_pair_check.name: invitations_acceptance_pair_check
invitations_acceptance_pair_check.value: ("invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "invitations"."accepted_by_membership_id" is null) or ("invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "invitations"."accepted_by_membership_id" is not null)

invitations_revocation_pair_check.name: invitations_revocation_pair_check
invitations_revocation_pair_check.value: ("invitations"."revoked_at" is null and "invitations"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("invitations"."revoked_at" is not null and "invitations"."revocation_reason" is not null)

invitations_supersession_pair_check.name: invitations_supersession_pair_check
invitations_supersession_pair_check.value: ("invitations"."superseded_at" is null and "invitations"."superseded_by_invitation_id" is null) or ("invitations"."superseded_at" is not null and "invitations"."superseded_by_invitation_id" is not null)

organization_logo_assets_lifecycle_check.name: organization_logo_assets_lifecycle_check
organization_logo_assets_lifecycle_check.value:
("organization_logo_assets"."status" = 'pending' and "organization_logo_assets"."activated_at" is null and "organization_logo_assets"."delete_pending_at" is null)
        or ("organization_logo_assets"."status" = 'active' and "organization_logo_assets"."activated_at" is not null and "organization_logo_assets"."delete_pending_at" is null)
        or ("organization_logo_assets"."status" = 'delete_pending' and "organization_logo_assets"."delete_pending_at" is not null)

organization_memberships_revocation_pair.name: organization_memberships_revocation_pair_check
organization_memberships_revocation_pair.value: ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'active' and "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" is null and "organization_memberships"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'revoked' and "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" is not null and "organization_memberships"."revocation_reason" is not null)

orphan_storage_cleanup_lifecycle_check.name: orphan_storage_cleanup_lifecycle_check
orphan_storage_cleanup_lifecycle_check.value:
("orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."status" = 'pending' and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."claimed_at" is null and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."status" = 'claimed' and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."claimed_at" is not null and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."status" = 'completed' and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."claimed_at" is not null and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."completed_at" is not null)
        or ("orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."status" = 'failed' and "orphan_storage_cleanup_ledger"."completed_at" is null)
